body.description: Pixel-art diorama: an intimate lived-in refuge at a dungeon entrance. Broad connected color clusters, compact heroic silhouettes, matte planes, crisp stepped edges, quiet shadow masses and selective details. 8-12 varied mercenaries talk in pairs, share bowls and mend equipment, amid bedrolls, patched cloth and sacks. Exactly ONE small mage stands apart, STRICTLY BACK TO CAMERA, entirely in deep architectural shadow. Opaque black hood and cloak conceal face, skin, hands, hair, age and gender; no rim light. Nobody notices, looks toward or reacts to the mage. Social warmth belongs to others; the mage is excluded from their connections. No war, army, battlefield, ruined city, monsters, epic scale, magic glow, grain, dithering, text, icons or HUD. PLACE: Shallow rooms carved into a cavern face connect by a cramped switchback stair. Cloth screens and timber doors are patched. Mercenaries talk on separate ledges; mage sheltered in an unlit stair recess. No monumental cliff city. COMPOSITION: View partly behind a close dark rock edge; cropped staircase zigzags into depth. COLOR SCRIPT: chalk bone stone, ink blue shadows, ash brown wood, tiny dull gold accents. Restrained saturation, a legible dark mage silhouette. One complete scene with a quiet dark surrounding field, no decorative frame.
